text: The user asked whether 132 could be made from 2, 8, 25, and 100 using +, −, ×, ÷, with each number used at most once and 125 forbidden as an intermediate. The assistant repeatedly gave incorrect answers and incorrectly insisted there was a solution. An exhaustive check later found no valid expression. The user confirmed the puzzle has no solution and chose to leave it there; the assistant acknowledged the mistake and apologized.
